In this setting, epistemic states of an agent are represented by possibility distributions.

arxiv-2106-04812.title: Phase Retrieval using Single-Instance Deep Generative Prior
arxiv-2106-04812.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by . Several deep learning methods for phase retrieval exist, but most of them fail on realistic data without precise support information. We propose a novel method based on single-instance deep generative prior that works well on complex-valued crystal data.

arxiv-2206-11996.title: The Real Deal: A Review of Challenges and Opportunities in Moving Reinforcement Learning-Based Traffic Signal Control Systems Towards Reality
arxiv-2206-11996.creator: Rex Chen, Fei Fang, Norman Sadeh
arxiv-2206-11996.description: Abstract Traffic signal control (TSC) is a high-stakes domain that is growing in importance as traffic volume grows globally. An increasing number of works are applying reinforcement learning (RL) to TSC; RL can draw on an abundance of traffic data to improve signalling efficiency. However, RL-based signal controllers have never been deployed.

arxiv-2512-16232.creator: Xin Wang, Zhao-Min Gao
arxiv-2512-16232.description: Abstract Parametric amplification offers a powerful means to enhance quantum interactions through field squeezing, yet it typically introduces additional noise which accelerates quantum decoherence, a major obstacle for scalable quantum information processing. The squeezing field is implemented in cavities rather than continuous waveguides, thereby limiting its scalability for applications in quantum simulation.

pmc-10551850.title: Safety of Single High-Dose Liposomal Amphotericin B for Induction Treatment of Cryptococcal Meningitis and Histoplasmosis in People With HIV: A Systematic Review and Meta-analysis
pmc-10551850.creator: HeeEun Kang, John P Uy, Caroline C Ho, Heather B Blunt, Natalie B Riblet, Alessandro C Pasqualotto, Richard A Murphy
pmc-10551850.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). BackgroundEvidence for efficacy of single, high-dose liposomal amphotericin B (LAmB) in HIV-associated cryptococcal meningitis and histoplasmosis is growing. No systematic review has examined the safety of this regimen across multiple studies.MethodsWe systematically searched Medline, Scopus, and the Cochrane Library from inception to April 2023 for studies reporting grade 3 and 4 adverse events (AEs) with single high-dose LAmB vs traditional amphotericin regimens for HIV-associated fungal infections.ResultsThree trials (n = 946) were included.

pmc-10657369.description: The pathogenesis of hepatic fibrosis is driven by dysregulated metabolism precipitated by chronic inflammation. Rho-associated coiled-coil-containing protein kinases (ROCKs) have been implicated in these processes, however the ability of selective ROCK2 inhibition to target simultaneously profibrotic, pro-inflammatory and metabolic pathways remains undocumented.

pmc-12470612.creator: Diana Iulia Vasilescu, Adriana Mihaela Dan, Ion Dragomir, Sorin Liviu Vasilescu, Adrian Vasile Dumitru, Vlad Dima, Monica Mihaela Cîrstoiu
pmc-12470612.description: Introduction: Fetal Inflammatory Response Syndrome (FIRS) is widely acknowledged for its contribution to neonatal morbidity in premature infants. Being a systemic inflammatory process triggered by intrauterine infections or other stimuli, FIRS has gained significant attention due to its complex implications for neonatal adverse outcomes: preterm birth, early onset neonatal sepsis, death or long-term neurodevelopmental impairments.

pmc-12592387.title: Quantum interference and occupation control in high harmonic generation from monolayer WS2
pmc-12592387.creator: Minjeong Kim, Taeho Kim, Anna Galler, Dasol Kim, Alexis Chacon, Xiangxin Gong, Yuhui Yang, Rouli Fang, Kenji Watanabe, Takashi Taniguchi, B J Kim, Sang Hoon Chae, Moon-Ho Jo, Angel Rubio, Ofer Neufeld, Jonghwan Kim
pmc-12592387.description: Two-dimensional hexagonal materials such as transition metal dichalcogenides exhibit valley degrees of freedom, offering fascinating potential for valley-based quantum computing and optoelectronics. In nonlinear optics, the K and K’ valleys provide excitation resonances that can be used for ultrafast control of excitons, Bloch oscillations, and Floquet physics.

pmc-12729163.title: Breakage of an epidural catheter in the psoas muscle; case report
pmc-12729163.creator: Sandra Elias, Dareen Jammoul, Samantha Succar, Charbel Gerges, Kenny Younes, Maher Abdessater, Ramy ToumaSawaya, Micheline Bou Khalil, Vanda Yazbeck Karam, Nathalie Bteich
pmc-12729163.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). BackgroundThe rupture of an epidural catheter is an exceedingly uncommon complication during patient repositioning.Case presentationThis report presents an unprecedented event of an epidural catheter rupture at the level of the psoas muscle that was managed by conservative measures. The breakage occurred during an urgent catheter withdrawal, before the completion of the procedure, due to a vagal response in a patient enduring labor.ConclusionsConventionally, surgical removal of retained fragments is reserved for symptomatic patients. Patient education and proper follow-up are indicated in asymptomatic cases.

pmc-12771441.title: Chemical Characteristics of Ciprofloxacin and Its Degradation Products: On the Road to Understanding Its Potential Hazards
pmc-12771441.creator: Alexis Caballero, Emiliano Perez-Sanchez, Amauri Serrano-Lázaro, Monserrat Bizarro, Ana Martínez
pmc-12771441.description: Antibiotics such as ciprofloxacin (CIP) are considered emerging contaminants because of their widespread use in human and veterinary medicine, their persistence in the environment, and their incomplete removal during wastewater treatment. To mitigate pollution, the photocatalytic degradation of antibiotics is an available option. However, some of the degradation products could be more harmful than the original compound.

pmc-13445499.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Background and ObjectivesEnlarged perivascular spaces (EPVSs) in the basal ganglia (BG-EPVS) are an important marker of cerebral small vessel disease (cSVD), and EPVS in the centrum semiovale (CSO-EPVS) are part of the diagnostic criteria for cerebral amyloid angiopathy.

pmc-13577992.title: Defining the Potential for Disease Modification in Atopic Dermatitis
pmc-13577992.creator: Eric L Simpson, Amy S Paller, Oscar Palomares, Thomas Bieber
pmc-13577992.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Atopic dermatitis is a common inflammatory disorder affecting the skin, often associated with a strong disease burden and a long-term impact on patients’ quality of life. Although most treatments for atopic dermatitis have been mainly focusing on alleviating symptoms, emerging therapies and approaches may offer the potential to modify the disease course, thereby leading to off-treatment remission and prevention of comorbidities. However, a consensus on the definition of disease modification in atopic dermatitis is yet to be reached.
